name: sym1-name-never-becomes-jamy
_why: Windows handoff §1.4 #1 — the original Mac bug: a common word must stay.

name: sym1-and-never-becomes-andre
_why: §1.4 #1 — short common words sit outside the edit budget.

name: sym3-multiword-apply-never-doubles
_why: §1.4 #3 — 'Claude code' heard as 'claud code' becomes 'Claude Code', never 'Claude Code code'.

name: sym5-never-inserts-unsaid-words
_why: §1.4 #5 — 'Claude wrote' must not become 'Claude Code wrote'.

name: sym6-merged-word-takes-the-longer-term
_why: §1.4 #6 — 'Ramanathan' goes to 'Ramaa Nathan' (merged-form alias), never the shorter 'Ramaa'.

name: sym7-possessive-never-rewritten
_why: §1.4 #7 — the skeleton drops the apostrophe; the guard keeps 'Mariana's'.

name: sym8-identity-claimed-first-keeps-initial
_why: §1.4 #8 — 'George W' must not collapse to 'George' (identity spans are claimed first).

name: sym12-all-caps-term-still-found
_why: §1.4 #12 — a term typed ALL CAPS must still match (skeletons are lowercased).

name: sym13-unknown-language-fails-closed
_why: §1.4 #13 — an unmeasured language gets nothing, never English's setting.

name: osa-transposition-is-one-edit
_why: Converged corrector: restricted Damerau-Levenshtein charges a swapped letter pair ONE edit, so a 5-char term (budget 1) still matches.

name: short-term-needs-exact-match
_why: Converged corrector: a skeleton of 3 or fewer characters gets an edit budget of 0.

name: ambiguous-tie-between-terms-is-dropped
_why: Converged corrector: a window two different terms reach equally well is dropped, not resolved by list order.

name: edit-budget-refuses-what-the-old-ceiling-took
_why: Converged corrector: 'Sridao' is 2 edits from 'Sriram' (budget 2, 0.33) but 'Pavan' is 2 edits from 'Maran' at length 5 (budget 1) — the old flat 0.45 ceiling accepted it.
